messages:
Alex M: Heads-up — after the PR merged earlier (4598) canary is showing a slow drift in p95. Looks like kernel selection is triggering compile storms for short seqs, ~12% p95 regression on canary.
ci-bot: CI perf-alert: job runtime/inference_perf failed: p95 latency +15% vs baseline. https://ci.internal/reports/4598
Priya S: Can you paste the kernel-picker logs from the canary run? is it falling back to slower kernels or repeatedly compiling?
Alex M: Kernel picker excerpt from canary:
```
[INFO] pick: model=redwood-13b, seq=64, candidate=int8_opt, score=0.42
[INFO] pick: model=redwood-13b, seq=64, candidate=float16_fast, score=0.67
[WARN] heuristic: picked int8_opt (lower score) due to compile_cache_miss=true
```
Alex M: Notice it picked int8_opt despite lower score because compile_cache_miss was true. That causes an expensive compile path to run and then churn the compile queue.
Rick G: We also saw a KV-cache eviction spike around the same window — compile_cache_kv evictions jumped from ~4/s to ~200/s for the canary hosts.
kate: Profiler snapshot shows compile time per kernel went from ~2.3s to ~8.9s on first hits, and the compile queue backlog grew. Flame snippet (top stacks):
```
0.  compile_kernel()    8.9s
1.  link_kernels()      3.2s
2.  cuda_jit_build()    2.1s
```
Priya S: Sounds like a combo of two changes: PR 9fadb3 (autopick heuristic thresholds) and 3bb1e6 (compile_cache TTL/eviction change). 9fadb3 adjusted the scoring bias; 3bb1e6 made cache more aggressive in invalidating entries when shard ids rotate.
Alex M: Bisect candidates: 9fadb3 (heuristic tweak) -> high priority, 3bb1e6 (cache TTL) -> secondary. If we can reproduce locally, we can confirm which one causes repeated compile_cache_miss.
Rick G: I'll kick off a bisect run on canary nodes now (job: bisect-compile-2104443300). Starting with reverting 9fadb3 locally to see signal.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused: canary-tier inference-runtime v2026.11.04 due to perf alert. :warning:
Priya S: Short-term mitigation: I'm going to push a hotfix that biases selection toward cached kernels (select_bias += 0.3) so we prefer slower-but-cached kernels over uncached faster ones. Should reduce compile churn until we bisect.
Alex M: Good. Action items: Rick to finish bisect; if 9fadb3 reproduces rollback candidate, revert immediately. Priya to open hotfix PR for select_bias and a config override for canary. Kate to add a watch metric: compile_count_per_model_per_min and compile_queue_length alert.
ci-bot: Perf rerun queued: job-id 4598-bisect-1. Will post results when complete.
Alex M: Thanks — keep this thread updated. If bisect yields noisy signal, we'll snapshot a repro trace and escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
